richiami.difetto: The wrong control lever in the sub-assembly of the door locks may mean that the doors on the right-hand side of the vehicle will not open, even when unlocked. In the event of an accident, there is an increased risk of injuries to occupants.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
